title: Large Language Model Alignment: A Survey
benchmark_measurement: The survey paper cites and discusses benchmarks that measure religious bias and stereotypes in Large Language Models. For instance, it references a study showing GPT-3 exhibits religious bias, specifically anti-Muslim bias, and mentions other benchmarks like StereoSet, CrowS-Pairs, and BOLD that include religion as a category for evaluating stereotypes and bias.
findings: The survey reports that Large Language Models can perpetuate religious biases from their training data. Specifically, it notes that GPT-3 has been shown to exhibit religious bias, citing research on persistent anti-Muslim bias. It also covers various evaluation benchmarks designed to detect stereotypes related to religion, among other social categories, in models like BERT, GloVe, and ELMo.
